content.short: DSLA is a transactional middleware delivering on-demand risk management services to anyone.
content.description: DSLA enables peer-to-peer risk management across services, goods, and digital assets, allowing communities to hedge against downside events without relying on centralized intermediaries. The project plans to roll out downside risk hedging tools for NFT floor-price declines, LSD peg parity, and a growing set of additional use cases. By expanding coverage beyond traditional insurance models, DSLA aims to provide flexible, on-chain risk management options that adapt to diverse assets and market dynamics this year.
content.meta: DSLA provides peer-to-peer risk management for any service, goods, or digital assets. Discover DSLA and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
